author: Андрей Романенко
attribution: Photo: Андрей Романенко, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ice-cream_shop_Serendipity_in_Nettuno.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Oval fascia of an ice-cream shop over a rusty roller shutter, Viale Giacomo Matteotti 71, Nettuno; 'GELATERIA' left and 'ARTIGIANALE' right of a cone icon. House-number tile '71' on the left pillar. Distractors: menu strips (GRANITA AL CAFFE', BRIOCHE, FRAPPE', CREPES, YOGURT, BANANA SPLIT), ho-mobile.it flag/chalkboard and NOKIA / HUAWEI / SAMSUNG window lettering of the shop next door. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

A square wall panel above repeats 'PARRUCCHIERIA / HAIR CARE' around a drawn face with a small tagline that is not reliably legible; door decal and doormat repeat the name. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Blackcat
